relationships.subject: galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: Galcanezumab, a monoclonal antibody against calcitonin gene-related peptide, is an emerging migraine preventative.

relationships.subject: galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: our data demonstrated that galcanezumab modulates pain thresholds specifically in the V1 dermatome, but this modulation is short-lasting

key_findings: Galcanezumab raised heat and mechanical pain thresholds in the V1 dermatome only, transiently and unrelated to clinical response
Baseline forearm heat pain threshold predicted clinical response
